answer:
The switch is the server-side environment variable `SB_DISABLE_SERVICE_WORKER`. Setting it to any value turns off the client service worker for all clients. That disables [[Sync]], so the space isn't copied into the browser, and the app won't work offline. All loads and saves go directly to the server.

The sources are `ADR/001 Offline-First PWA.md`, `Install/Configuration.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
